profile.name: Divyanshu Kumar
profile.education: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
profile.bio: Full Stack Web Developer (MERN) and B.Tech Computer Science graduate with hands-on internship experience building scalable web applications using React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and MySQL. Experienced in REST APIs, authentication, Git/GitHub, CI/CD, Agile development, and cloud deployment. Passionate about building secure, reliable, and user-focused web products.
profile.availability: Available for Full-time Roles & Freelance Projects

projects.title: NovaVault — Enterprise Workspace & Document Management
projects.tagline: Collaborative document & team asset management platform with real-time sync and RBAC.

prd.author: Divyanshu Kumar (Lead Full Stack Engineer)
prd.problemStatement: Distributed teams struggle with fragmented document versions, slow search times, and inadequate permission governance across multi-tenant departments.
prd.targetAudience: Startups, remote engineering teams, and enterprise product squads needing compliant, fast asset sharing.
userStories: As an Admin, I want role-based permissions (Viewer, Editor, Admin) so sensitive docs remain protected.
As a User, I want real-time search with tags and fuzzy filtering to find documents in < 150ms.
As a Collaborator, I want automated document versioning and activity audit logs.
prd.technicalArchitecture: Three-tier architecture with React SPA frontend, stateless Express REST API backend, JWT + HttpOnly cookies authentication, MongoDB document store with text indexes, and AWS S3 for encrypted file blobs.
keyFeatures: S3 Direct Multipart Upload with Presigned URLs
Real-time activity audit trails & notification hooks
prd.metrics: Sub-180ms average API response time, 99.9% uptime in load testing, 45% reduction in search latency.

projects.title: PulseFlow — Real-Time Product Analytics & Heatmap Engine
projects.tagline: High-throughput event ingestion API & interactive analytics dashboard for user behavioral insights.

prd.author: Divyanshu Kumar
prd.problemStatement: High SaaS analytics costs and bloated client SDKs slow down web applications while providing rigid, delayed reporting.
prd.targetAudience: Product Managers, Growth Marketers, and Engineering Leads tracking conversion funnels.
userStories: As an Engineer, I need a lightweight < 5KB tracking script to send custom telemetry events.
As a Marketer, I want dynamic funnel visualization to pinpoint user drop-off points.
As an Admin, I want real-time active user telemetry updated every 3 seconds.
prd.technicalArchitecture: Express event ingestion microservice with batched write buffering into MongoDB, Redis caching layer for instant query aggregation, and React dashboard with customizable chart widgets.
keyFeatures: Interactive conversion funnel & retention cohort charts
Custom event filtering, geographic breakdowns, and device stats
CSV/JSON export & automated email digest scheduling
apiEndpoints: GET /api/v1/analytics/realtime — Active sessions and live events
prd.metrics: Ingested 10M+ mock events in stress tests with zero packet drop; average aggregation latency < 90ms.

projects.title: ShopNexus — Modern Headless E-Commerce Platform
projects.tagline: Ultra-fast headless commerce store with inventory locking, Stripe checkout, and merchant CMS.

prd.author: Divyanshu Kumar
prd.problemStatement: Legacy e-commerce sites suffer from slow checkout speeds, cart abandonment due to stock race conditions, and clunky mobile experiences.
prd.targetAudience: Direct-to-consumer lifestyle brands and modern retail businesses.
userStories: As a Shopper, I want instant cart updates and 1-click checkout with Stripe.
As a Merchant, I want real-time stock sync and low-inventory alerts.
As an Admin, I want a unified order fulfillment and customer refund interface.
prd.technicalArchitecture: React with Tailwind CSS for instant hydration and mobile gestures; Express.js backend connected to MySQL with ACID transactions for inventory reservation; Stripe Webhook handler for verified payment settlements.
keyFeatures: Atomic inventory locking prevents double-booking during peak sales
Stripe Payment Elements integration (Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay)
Dynamic product variants (Size, Color, Material) with live SKU lookup
Admin Order Management with status workflows & tracking updates
apiEndpoints: GET /api/v1/products — Filtered catalog by categories & price range
prd.metrics: Lighthouse Performance Score 98/100, 1.2s average checkout completion time.

projects.title: AgileTrack — Collaborative Task Management & Sprint Suite
projects.tagline: Drag-and-drop Kanban workflow tool with sprint velocity tracking, task dependencies, and mentions.

prd.author: Divyanshu Kumar
prd.problemStatement: Existing project management tools are overly complex, bloated with useless features, and slow to load on mobile.
prd.targetAudience: Agile engineering teams, designers, and freelance contractors.
userStories: As a Developer, I want smooth drag-and-drop column transitions to update ticket statuses effortlessly.
As a Scrum Master, I want automatic burndown charts generated per 2-week sprint cycle.
As a Team Member, I want markdown comments with @mentions.
prd.technicalArchitecture: Optimistic UI updates on frontend with React state; Express REST API with MongoDB transactional status updates and WebSocket broadcast for collaborative board sync.
keyFeatures: Zero-lag drag and drop Kanban boards with custom swimlanes
Sprint backlog prioritization and estimation point calculators
Markdown support in task descriptions and discussion threads
apiEndpoints: GET /api/v1/boards/:id — Full board status with columns and tickets
PUT /api/v1/tickets/:id/move — Update card position and column state
prd.metrics: Zero UI stuttering (60fps drag animations), < 50ms optimistic state reconciliation.
